name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whew, hearing the teacher’s past story... that was a real shock, wasn't it~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I guess.」
After that, I didn't go back to the dorm and ended up taking a walk with Setsugekka. Somehow, I just couldn't help but talk about it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I always figured there was definitely something there. I’m a little relieved you told us without holding back.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah... Muragaki-sensei must have had it really rough, not being able to tell anyone until now, right?」
Muragaki Iori is almost foolishly earnest.
He shows absolutely no sign of selfishness, is always kind, and gives us sincere encouragement.
A person like a saint couldn't possibly be born from nothing.
I’m sure the teacher’s kindness is just the flip side of the guilt he feels himself.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I wonder if Sensei will disappear once the Martial Festival is over.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, you’ve got other things to worry about, don't you? What are you planning to do about Keisetsu?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah—! That too! What should I do~!」
Setsugekka starts holding her head in distress.

name: Momiji
message: 「You don't want to leave Keisetsu and live in Japan？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s not that I don't want to... but I don't think that’s right. Because I’ve been getting help from Kei-chan non-stop, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can’t let Kei-chan go to dangerous places all by herself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, if Kei-chan is going, I plan on going too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I see... then it’s goodbye for us too, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuu... I don't want that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don't want to! I don't want to say goodbye to Momimomi, Momimomi come with me too~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-there’s no way I could do something like that!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuu, yeah, I guess so... oh man, what do I do...」
Setsugekka’s words saved me just a little bit. It means she doesn't want to be separated from me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, isn't there some way for me to stay with Kei-chan and not have to say goodbye to Momimomi either？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, use your Shingan no Kiwamete and think it up real quick.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ve told you, that’s not what it’s for!」
Honestly, what a handful she is.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, though... there is one way.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, really！？ What kind of way？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Get Keisetsu to stop going abroad. That's it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...I see. But that’s impossible, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wouldn’t say it’s impossible, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh？ What do you mean？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Keisetsu’s dream is to become the head of the Kazamine family. Going abroad isn’t the only way to achieve that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, we just need to present her with a different way to become the head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A different way...」
I mean, if such a way really existed, Keisetsu would have jumped on it long ago. In reality, it’s as good as nonexistent.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that’s it! That’s the way!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh-what is？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Basically, Kei-chan just needs to be recognized by the head of the family, right？ If so, it’s simple. There’s only one thing to do！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I just have to become the Toujinegi！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, if I win the Martial Festival and become the Toujinegi, Keisetsu shouldn’t have to go abroad anymore！」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-well, I wonder about that.」
I don’t think it’s quite that simple, though.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh right, I’ll try asking about the teacher while I’m at it too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That ‘errand’ Muragaki-sensei mentioned? It turns out Kei-chan actually asked her boss to assign it to him, you know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh, really！？」
That’s news to me. I mean, Keisetsu has more power than I thought...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If she has that kind of influence, she should be able to ask him to keep sending us on these ‘errands’ until we graduate！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wonder if it’ll go that smoothly...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t know, but I’m going to try asking at least. I don’t want to give up without doing anything.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I see... yeah, you’re right.」
If Keisetsu and Setsugekka could both stay at the academy just like this. And if Sensei could stay just the same as always.

name: Momiji
message: （I really hope it turns out that way...）

name: Momiji
message: 「...Still, in the end, that's only if you can actually become Toujinegi, right, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm？ Well, yeah.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then that's impossible. I'm the one who's going to become Toujinegi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-Hey, don't get cocky! Why are you talking like your victory's already in the bag, you jerk!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I already told you, I'm gonna win and become Toujinegi！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And like I said, I'm going to stop you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're not stopping me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, yes I am.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm definitely gonna take you down, Momimomi！」

name: Setsugekka & Momiji
message: 「Hmph...！」
We glare at each other.

name: Momiji
message: 「Haah, let's drop this already. We'll be at it all day.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's right—you never know who's gonna win or lose a match until you actually fight, right?」
Maybe so. After all, upsets do happen in this world.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Just you wait—I'm definitely gonna convince Kei-chan!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I'll wait without getting my hopes up.」
Still, I hope it goes well.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, by the way, Momimomi, there's something I wanted to ask you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What are you planning to do after graduating from Murakumo Academy？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh...? You mean my dream for the future? Hmm, I wonder.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, as for me...」

name: Momiji
message: 「I know. A pro Jindou player, right?」
As if I wouldn't know—I've heard it enough times to give my ears calluses. Still, Secchan always talks about it so happily, no matter how many times.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's right! I'm gonna market myself with a super-cool heel persona, just like Nakamura Sakura!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is that even okay for the Kazamine image？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, could it be a no-go？ Uwaaah, I never thought of that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I've gotta ask Kei-chan about this too!」
Keisetsu sure has it rough...
I can totally understand why Keisetsu said she wanted Sensei to take her place.
Still, though. Honestly, when I see Setsugekka like that... I envy her.
Pure, heading straight toward whatever she sets her mind to. I don't have that kind of beauty.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, so？ What's your dream, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, if I had to say... a <d0084>hermit</d>, maybe.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A hermit？ Living all alone deep in the mountains all the time？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that kind of hermit.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Normally I'd just laze around deep in the mountains drinking sake, and act all high and mighty to whatever youngsters drop by every now and then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That is the kind of person I wish to become.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're way too much of a hopeless bum, Momimomi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, that's not nice, making fun of someone's dream.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, if you did that, I wouldn't be able to see you whenever I wanted. Pick a different dream.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why do I have to change it to suit you, Setsugekka？！」
Setsugekka is as selfish as ever.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Hey, Momimomi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「What？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The Martial Festival starts next week, huh.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Once the Martial Festival starts, I wonder if that means we'll be enemies.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Who knows... It won't be any different from usual, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see—so we can just keep things as usual, right？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's what I'm planning on doing, anyway.」
Of course, during an actual match is another story.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thank goodness. I was wondering what I’d do if Momimomi suddenly turned into a cold person.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha, I wouldn’t do that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momimomi… let’s do our best at the Martial Festival！」
Setsugekka thrust her fist out toward me.

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, of course.」
I made a fist of my own and bumped it gently against hers.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Win or lose, let’s make sure we have no regrets.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Though it’ll be me who wins.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh, I’m used to that taunting by now. Keep underestimating me and you’re going to be embarrassed at the Martial Festival, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m not underestimating you. I’m going all out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, me too. Momimomi is my rival, after all!」
With our fists pressed together, we fueled each other’s fighting spirit.

name: Momiji
message: （…A rival, huh）
Iori-sensei had a friend who was both his rival and his best friend.
That must have been a girl just like this Setsugekka, who is standing right in front of me now—
